author: sauliusgrigaitis
content: <@592004585506340885> how hard it would be to get test vectors for EIP-8321? It can be either just on top of Gloas, or a feature fork.

author: jtraglia
content: It would be pretty easy. But they aren't currently provided on github. You would clone the consensus-specs repo & run `make test reftests=true fork=eip8321`. The generated tests will be output to `reftests`.
